intro: Croatia curves like a boomerang around Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a long Adriatic coast of more than a thousand islands and inland plains and mountains.

chapters.title: Coast and islands
text: The Dalmatian coast is lined with more than 1,200 islands and islets, such as Hvar, Brač and Korčula. Dubrovnik's walled old town sits on the southern coast; since 2022 a bridge to the Pelješac peninsula has linked it by road to the rest of Croatia without crossing Bosnia.
Croatia borders Slovenia, Hungary, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Montenegro.

chapters.title: Lakes and mountains
text: The Plitvice Lakes are 16 turquoise lakes linked by waterfalls, a World Heritage Site. The Dinaric Alps run behind the coast, and the flat plain of Slavonia in the east is good farmland.
